purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kitui West Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: This form labels its first numeric column 'Voters per Polling Station' rather than 'Registered Voters', but it is the same field (confirmed against the governed denominator, see below). The polling-station list spans pages 1-2 with the single grand TOTAL row printed at the foot of page 2 (not shaded, so the automated green-band locator did not isolate it); page 3 is the signature/handover page. Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF at 150 DPI. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity ('Name of Constituency: KITUI WEST Code: 070', 'Name of County: KITUI Code: 015') was read from the page-1 header and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 070' banner marker on both pages before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. The printed 'Voters per Polling Station' TOTAL figure (59,047) matches the governed P23 ward-summed registered-voters denominator (KDA-VOTERS-CON-070-2022) exactly, and the four candidate cells sum exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
